items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I played with Connish too. Connish played Tramon with me too.

ctx.x: Yeah, sometimes. You don't get the breaks.

Yeah, you don't get that break. You know what I'm talking? But every time that boy see me he talk that same thing, you know what I mean? And so, and you know, playing together so long, you see, together, you see? And 15 years we played there, you see, in that one place. You see? Well, that's by playing so long in one place nobody don't know nothing about you, you see? In fact, well, we used to play a lot over here when they had a lot of dance halls. See, when I was living down here on Annette Street with this…
